subject.title: fix(agents): pass attemptNumber instead of apiKeyIndex to retry callbacks (#102938)

question: Should the shipped plugin-SDK `attempt` field remain a supported key-index alias, or should OpenClaw formally deprecate it with a documented removal window?
rationale: The runtime fix is mechanically assessable, but only the plugin API owners can decide whether an existing shipped callback field is permanent compatibility surface or scheduled for removal.

options.title: Keep the alias supported
options.body: Remove the deprecation annotation, retain `attempt === apiKeyIndex`, and add the explicit fields as a non-breaking clarification.

options.title: Approve a deprecation plan
options.body: Keep the annotation only with maintainer-approved migration guidance, compatibility tests, and a stated release and removal window.

recommendation.title: Keep the alias supported
recommendation.body: Remove the deprecation annotation, retain `attempt === apiKeyIndex`, and add the explicit fields as a non-breaking clarification.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current per-key retry loop and are closest to the intended callback semantics.
